text: 1. Having completed recognized upper secondary or equivalent Year 12 studies to the required standard 2. Having satisfied the English language requirements. Undergraduate applicants who provide TOEFL scores of at least 79 Internet-based (IBT) or an IELTS overall band score of at least 6.0 or TOEIC scores of 750 will be considered for regular admission. 3. Over 18 years old.
